```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Run tests
        run: bun run test
```
